entities.name: SurE 5'-nucleotidase
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed UniProt Q11WK5 from Cytophaga hutchinsonii; annotated as a 5'-nucleotidase (EC 3.1.3.5).
Hydrolyzes nucleoside 5'-monophosphates; associated with one divalent metal cation per subunit.

entities.name: 5'-nucleotide hydrolysis
observations: Rhea RHEA:12484: ribonucleoside 5'-phosphate + H2O = ribonucleoside + phosphate.
